item.title: Gunsmoke - Byline
item.description: Despite his illiteracy, Festus becomes a reporter for Dodge's new paper.

item.title: The Waltons - The Honeymoon
item.description: Olvia and John finally get a chance to take their postponed honeymoon to Virginia Beach

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Killer Bee
item.description: A psychiatric worker is trying to drive a fellow Vietnam veteran crazy.

item.title: Matlock - The Sisters
item.description: When he is accused of murdering his wealthy wife, an old acquaintance hires Matlock to defend him. The more digging Matlock does, the more he begins to suspect other family members.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Angry Astronaut
item.description: Astronaut Matthew Heller is suspected of killing his old service rival, General Addison Brand, after Brand is put in charge of the astronaut program.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver's Good Deed
item.description: Beaver seems to be on a selfish streak after backing out of a babysitting and later not wanting to do a simple favor for Wally. Ward gives Beaver a stern lecture and he soon takes Ward's advice when a tramp comes to the door wanting some kindness. However, the tramp quickly takes advantage and helps himself to more than a glass of water.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - More Blessed to Give
item.description: Beaver and Gilbert go to a carnival and Beaver surprisingly wins a fourteen caret gold locket in one of the carnival games. Beaver thinks about giving it to June but, thanks to Gilbert, decides to give it to a girl whom he has a crush on. However, soon it becomes apparent that this was a mistake when the girl's parents discover Beaver's gift.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Digital Detox
item.description: "Toony's forced to unplug on a digital detox retreat."

item.title: Adam-12 - Extortion
item.description: Malloy stares down the barrel of a rifle during the search for gloved robbers who are able to make off with $500 from a tavern in a stolen car. He and Reed also try to apprehend a group of anti-semites before their repeated shakedown attempts cause further damage to a defiant Holocaust survivor.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 125: Safe Job
item.description: There's been a rash of cracked safes in the area, and Malloy thinks the suspect is someone who lives in the neighborhood who now claims to be a reformed family man. In the meantime, he and Reed track down a female robbery suspect, who turns out to be a victim herself.
